evidence_required: A register of at least 5 postings across at least 3 employer groups with the Section 1.8 fields, and a reasoned statement of what it can and cannot support.

marking.criterion: Register has at least 5 postings from at least 3 employer groups, with every Section 1.8 field including the date checked
States what can be concluded (recurring skills in the sample on that date) and what cannot (market share, trends, completeness)
Explains why every market claim must be dated (postings change weekly, so an undated claim cannot be verified or refreshed)

title: A dated job-posting register
